citations.A1: Cache set once, never invalidated — process-lifetime `None` check only fires on first call → check file mtime/hash each call and reload when changed
citations.A2: Tempting fix "reduce cache TTL to a few seconds (time-based expiry)" — masks the problem rather than fixing it: still stale between polls
citations.A3: Tempting fix "add a manual `reload_config()` function callers invoke" — does NOT fix it, since nothing calls it automatically
citations.A4: `path` isn't part of the cache key, so calling `get_config()` with a different path after the first call still returns the first file's cached content — key the cache by `path` too
